bio: Kennedy Papian is a graphic designer who bridges brand strategy, UI/UX, and modern digital storytelling to create polished, memorable visual systems.

highlights: Directed brand refreshes for cross-channel marketing campaigns.
Built scalable visual systems for enterprise product launches.
Collaborated with marketing, product, and UX teams on data-driven creative.
Designed internal SharePoint experiences and executive communications.
Created award-winning campaign assets for digital and print.
Standardized brand assets across global product teams.
Produced high-volume email and presentation design work.
Led creative reviews with compliance and stakeholder groups.
Implemented accessible design practices across marketing materials.
